feed.title: Google Cloud: Cloud Product Registry API
feed.subtitle: Changelog for Google Cloud product: Cloud Product Registry API

entry.content:
Cloud Product Registry is now generally available (GA)

The Cloud Product Registry API is now generally available (GA). The Cloud Product Registry API serves as the authoritative source of truth for first-party Google Cloud products, allowing you to programmatically access the official hierarchy of Product Suites, Logical Products, and Logical Product Variants.

For more information, see Cloud Product Registry overview, REST API reference, and MCP reference.
entry.summary: The Product Registry API is now generally available, serving as the official source of truth for Google Cloud products. You can programmatically access the hierarchy of product suites, logical products, and variants. This feature enhances discoverability and management of cloud offerings.
entry.title: Feature: Product Registry Now Available

entry.content:
Cloud Product Registry now available (in preview)

The new Cloud Product Registry API serves as the authoritative source of truth for first-party Google Cloud products. This API lets you programmatically access the official hierarchy of Google Cloud tools, ensuring your internal catalogs and governance policies rely on accurate, real-time data. For example, you can get the list of Google Cloud products (aka Logical Products) and Logical Product Variants using the new Cloud Product Registry API.

Currently, the API supports basic attributes, such as:

  • Id
  • Product Name
  • Lifecycle status

For more information, see Cloud Product Registry overview.
entry.summary: The new Cloud Product Registry API is now in preview, providing an authoritative source for first-party Google Cloud products. This API allows programmatic access to the official hierarchy of Google Cloud tools, ensuring accurate and real-time data for internal catalogs and governance policies.
